lemmas.name: nonneg_sw
lemmas.statement: ∀ (heights : List Int) (w : Nat → Int), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → ∀ (n i : Nat) (acc : Int), heights.length - i ≤ n → 0 ≤ acc → 0 ≤ rain_postcond.sum_water heights w i acc
lemmas.proof:
by intro heights w hw n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro i acc hn hacc
    rw [rain_postcond.sum_water]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hacc
    · omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro i acc hn hacc
    rw [rain_postcond.sum_water]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hacc
    · exact ih (i + 1) _ (by omega) (by have := hw i; omega)

lemmas.name: rain62
lemmas.statement: ∀ (heights : List Int) (h : rain_precond heights), rain_postcond heights (if heights.length < 3 then 0 else rain_postcond.sum_water heights (fun i => max 0 (min (rain_postcond.ml heights i 0 0) (rain_postcond.mr heights i 0) - heights[i]!)) 0 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro heights h
  unfold rain_postcond
  by_cases hl : heights.length < 3
  · rw [if_pos hl]; refine ⟨le_refl _, ?_⟩; rw [if_pos hl]
  · rw [if_neg hl]
    refine ⟨nonneg_sw heights _ (fun i => le_max_left _ _) heights.length 0 0 (by omega) (le_refl _), ?_⟩
    rw [if_neg hl]
